# Constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Constraint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The abstract base of a condition on a rights rule ([odrl:Constraint](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Constraint)) — specialised by [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) (a [`leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) / operator / [`rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) comparison, e.g. dateTime ≤ 2030, spatial = EU, count ≤ 5) and [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md) (a boolean combination of constraints). A licence's temporal bound is an [`AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) over the dateTime operand.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the abstract base only when reasoning over any rule condition regardless of kind; for a concrete condition mint a [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) (one comparison) or a [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md) (a boolean combination).

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing an instance as a bare [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md) (the two kinds are disjoint and one always applies) and avoid using a constraint where a simple validity window suffices — a licence term is fine as [`gmeow:validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md).

### How to use

- Type the condition as [`AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) or [`LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md), attach it to a rule with [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](../properties/gmeow-ruleConstraint.md), and let the solver evaluate it; the rule holds only when all its constraints are satisfied.

### Examples

- ex:c a [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md); [`gmeow:leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) [`gmeow:leftOpSpatial`](../individuals/gmeow-leftOpSpatial.md); [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](../properties/gmeow-constraintOperator.md) [`gmeow:operatorEq`](../individuals/gmeow-operatorEq.md); [`gmeow:rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) "EU".
